purpose: An equivalence clause on the degree ('or equivalent experience'), years of experience with a domain sub-clause, two soft requirements written as sentences, an alternative (Jira or Linear), and a preferred section introduced by 'It would be great if you also bring:' instead of a nice-to-have heading. Tests that the equivalence clause stays inside its item, that soft sentences are requirements, and that the unlabelled section is classified preferred.
